title: Euphoria
author: Martyav
description:
An interlocking sci-fi/fantasy story about three characters that never actually meet in real life, "Euphoria" details the moments leading up to an unusual rescue mission.

The story is told in the second person and follows a teenager, a 10 year old child, and an adult. They live in a universe where space travel is commonplace, and many space stations exist between the Earth and Jupiter's moon Callisto. However, many details suggest it is set in an alternative timeline to the present, rather than a far-flung future.
